topic: Sweep the open-issue backlog: fix the well-specified small and medium issues in one run — #53 (follow-ups.json omitempty drops wave 0), #44 (follow-ups identity/de-dup), #43 (spec gate failure paths: checked gate_reviewed event write, an error reason on the receipt, a hash on reviews/<gate>.json), #23 (retro-inputs review_findings spans gate reviews and every attempt), #25 (wave_timings per dispatched attempt), #33 (status during the plan phase says planned/not materialised and confirmed clauses), #8 (unlock/status --slug hint when the bundle lives on another branch), #24 (goal-assessor citations validated as path:line inside a real file), #36 (PR title and body from the spec and goals rather than --fill), #26 (branch_finish does not recommend a merge it has disabled), #45 and #51 (the two polish checklists, minus the user-directory lens override), #54 (design §4.6 lock_taken wording by holder), #37 (skill invariant: absolute paths, never cd into the bundle), #35 (retro path in the plan doc), #18 (README macOS quarantine note), #49 item 1 (copilot --no-custom-instructions, if the CLI supports it). #34, #27 and #7 are already fixed in commit 4c5026d on this branch.

last_digest.summary: Removed the unreachable json.Marshal fallback in FollowUp.Key() per the review finding; the rest of the wave-pointer, idempotent-append and single-write-findings work was already in place, and all verify commands (tests, lint, greps) now pass — the earlier failure came from another task's citation change that has since been fixed.

The errored gate review now carries the backend's reason from receipt to question and offers retry/accept/stop instead of revise, `takt answer --choice retry` clears the gate without writing anything, branch_finish recommends the first enabled option (pr when merge is blocked), and questions.go says "twelve ids".
Added the review-record doctor check (WARN on a gate/findings-file hash mismatch, PASS otherwise), wired it into Default, and added its two tests; all specified verify commands pass.

Made the alignment summary total over unknown verdict words (so `alignment:` is provably never bare) with a test that drives the recorder, and removed the unreachable `ws.Repo` nil guard in `bundleHint`.

Goal-assessor citations are now parsed as `path:line`/`path:start-end` and validated for repo-relative containment (symlink-resolved), regular-file-ness and line range, with `readVerdicts` rejecting such a reply the way any unusable reply is rejected; tests and lint are green.
last_digest.blockers: none — the one deviation from the brief is that the requested `//nolint:gosec // G304` directive was omitted because gosec does not fire there and nolintlint fails the build on the unused directive; the reasoning is kept as a prose comment.

last_digest.summary: The task's changes were already complete in the tree from attempt 1; attempt 1 failed on another task's fixture, since fixed on the branch, and all verify commands — six greps, race tests, and lint — now pass.
Added `--no-custom-instructions` to `copilotArgs` with an explanatory doc comment, and pinned it in `TestCopilotArgs`; tests and lint pass.

Named `.goreleaser.yaml` as the quarantine hook's source in the README and addressed the four carried doc findings — §7.4's stale spec-excerpt illustration, a new §5.2 `gate_review` entry covering the error-path `retry`, §9's `Receipt.Reason`, §11's seven-check count plus `review-record` row, and the fixed-point design's `error` verdict row and edge case — while also fixing a line-initial ```json fence attempt 1 left in §8.2.

runReview now reads events for the round, retires the prior receipt on `--force` before the backend call, and writes findings → carry → checked `gate_reviewed` event (with reason) → receipt → commit; `reviews/<gate>.json` carries `hash` and `round` via a new `reviewRecord`, with five new failure-path tests and the two comment rewrites.

Retro inputs now count gate and task review findings once each from the event log (split as gate_review_findings/task_review_findings) and emit one wave timing per dispatched attempt that closed, with closed_at, committed and an omitzero committed_at; wave_closed carries slice and review_findings, which the close record also stores.

Corrected the push_pr template to the mandated `--body-file {{.PRBodyPath}}` form, fixed the malformed-record hint to stop advising a delete that leaves goals_checked_sha intact, made waivers key on map presence, unwrapped the doubled goals.md error, and added coverage for preparePushPR's own ReadGoals branch and the pr option's description.

Reworked the calls-log tests so the blind-review case asserts a single total reviewer call, added a cli test that drives the recording hook's failure branch, and de-duplicated the call-log parsing into shared helpers.

Updated agents/goal-assessor.md and agents/implementer.md per spec §E/G, regenerated the two matching hosts/copilot agent files via `task hosts:gen`, and confirmed hosts:check and internal/prompt tests pass.
